components.name: Blender
components.security: Install only from blender.org or an operating-system package manager.

components.name: Blender MCP
components.security: Arbitrary Python execution is intended. Bind to localhost only, disable telemetry, and keep remote asset-download integrations disabled.

components.name: Pillow
components.security: Install from PyPI or an operating-system package manager. The encoder reads only locally rendered PNG frames and writes one GIF.

components.name: Roblox Studio MCP
components.security: Use Roblox's built-in Studio MCP and verify the active place before executing Luau.

components.name: Blender Animations (ultimate edition)
components.security: Install only from the Creator Store listing. Keep auto-connect and live sync off unless Studio transfer is actively required.

components.name: Roblox Animations Importer/Exporter
components.security: Unmodified signed-release asset. Static audit found optional Roblox OAuth/asset network access and a localhost live-sync server. Registration does not start the server. Keep OAuth, online access, auto-connect, and live sync disabled unless explicitly needed.

components.name: R6 IK + FK Blender Rig V2.22
components.license: usage shared by author; redistribution license not stated
components.installation: Fetch automatically from the original author's DevForum attachments and verify every byte before use.
components.security: Audited with Blender auto-execution disabled. Five embedded scripts contain no network or process-launch code. The matching RBXM contains no Script, LocalScript, or ModuleScript instance. Activate embedded scripts only after both the blend hash and every text-block hash match.

components.name: Premade Roblox Studio R15 character
components.security: Create or select the stock premade R15 character inside Studio, then transfer it through Cautioned's Creator Store plugin. Never replace it with repository-generated geometry.

components.name: Roblox official R15 rig and attachments project files
components.security: The official archive was inspected with auto-execution disabled and contains no embedded Blender text, drivers, or external paths. It is a skeleton/attachment reference, not the visible premade authoring character, so do not substitute it for the Studio R15 workflow.
